title: Fair-Share Allocation
description: Fair-Share Allocation is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Divides total network storage fairly among peers by stake and need. Each peer's share is proportional to their contributed storage, recomputed as peers join or leave. It takes peer list, contributions and produces share table. Tunable parameters: proportional. Guarantee: shares always sum to the total.

fields.mechanism: Each peer's share is proportional to their contributed storage, recomputed as peers join or leave.
fields.guarantees: shares always sum to the total

demo.code:
function fair(total,peers){return peers?total/peers:0;}
console.log('Fair share: '+fair(17,3)+' GB');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Usage Metering
description: Usage Metering is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Meters every byte written with tamper-evident counters. Writes increment per-peer counters signed by the writer; counters are gossiped and cross-checked. It takes write events and produces signed counters. Tunable parameters: per byte. Guarantee: counters can only increase.

fields.mechanism: Writes increment per-peer counters signed by the writer; counters are gossiped and cross-checked.

title: Quota Enforcement
description: Quota Enforcement is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Refuses writes that would exceed a peer's quota, gracefully. Before each write the quota check runs; over-quota writes get a clear error naming the quota. It takes write request, quota and produces allow/deny. Tunable parameters: pre-write check. Guarantee: denials always name the quota and the overage.

fields.mechanism: Before each write the quota check runs; over-quota writes get a clear error naming the quota.
fields.guarantees: denials always name the quota and the overage

title: Proof of Storage
description: Proof of Storage is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Requires peers to prove they still hold the data they claim. Random chunk challenges are issued; peers must return the chunk hash within the deadline. It takes challenge and produces proof responses. Tunable parameters: deadline 5 min. Guarantee: failed proofs always reduce trust.

title: Replication Quotas
description: Replication Quotas is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Guarantees each chunk keeps its replica count without central control. Under-replicated chunks are advertised; peers with free quota claim them first-come. It takes chunk inventory and produces replica claims. Tunable parameters: target 3 replicas. Guarantee: no chunk ever drops below 2 replicas.

title: Burst Allowances
description: Burst Allowances is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Grants short burst capacity above quota for urgent writes. Each peer accrues burst tokens over time; a write can spend tokens to exceed quota briefly. It takes token balance and produces burst grants. Tunable parameters: accrue 1 GB/day. Guarantee: bursts never exceed 2× quota.

fields.mechanism: Each peer accrues burst tokens over time; a write can spend tokens to exceed quota briefly.

title: Quota Trading
description: Quota Trading is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Lets peers trade unused quota with each other directly. Trade offers are signed and matched peer-to-peer; the ledger updates both quotas atomically. It takes trade offers and produces updated quotas. Tunable parameters: atomic swap. Guarantee: trades never create quota from nothing.

fields.mechanism: Trade offers are signed and matched peer-to-peer; the ledger updates both quotas atomically.

title: Garbage Collection
description: Garbage Collection is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Reclaims space from deleted and expired data automatically. Expired chunks are listed by their TTL; collectors delete them and free the quota. It takes TTL index and produces freed space. Tunable parameters: daily sweep. Guarantee: live data is never collected.

fields.mechanism: Expired chunks are listed by their TTL; collectors delete them and free the quota.

title: Priority Tiers
description: Priority Tiers is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Gives critical data a protected quota tier that normal writes cannot touch. Each peer reserves a tier fraction for pinned data; tier accounting is separate. It takes tier config and produces tier usage. Tunable parameters: default 10%. Guarantee: pinned data is never evicted by normal writes.

fields.mechanism: Each peer reserves a tier fraction for pinned data; tier accounting is separate.

title: Audit Trails
description: Audit Trails is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Keeps a signed log of every quota decision for later audit. Grants, denials, and trades append to a hash-chained log each peer keeps. It takes quota events and produces audit log. Tunable parameters: hash-chained. Guarantee: log entries are never editable.

fields.mechanism: Grants, denials, and trades append to a hash-chained log each peer keeps.

title: Grace Periods
description: Grace Periods is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Gives over-quota peers a grace window to clean up before writes stop. First overage starts a 72-hour grace timer; writes continue but warn until it expires. It takes overage events and produces grace timers. Tunable parameters: 72 h. Guarantee: grace is granted once per 30 days.

fields.mechanism: First overage starts a 72-hour grace timer; writes continue but warn until it expires.

title: Offline Quota Cache
description: Offline Quota Cache is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Lets peers enforce quotas while offline from the network. Quota tables are cached with signatures; offline writes count against the cached quota. It takes cached tables and produces offline decisions. Tunable parameters: signed. Guarantee: offline writes always reconcile on reconnect.

title: Quota Alerts
description: Quota Alerts is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Warns peers at 80% and 95% of quota so nothing surprises them. Threshold crossings emit alerts; the 95% alert repeats daily until resolved. It takes usage stream and produces alerts. Tunable parameters: 80/95%. Guarantee: alerts always include the top consumers.

title: New Peer Bootstrap
description: New Peer Bootstrap is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Onboards new peers with a starter quota that grows with proven storage. New peers start at 10 GB; each passing month of valid proofs doubles it to the fair share. It takes proof history and produces grown quota. Tunable parameters: double monthly. Guarantee: bootstrap quota never exceeds fair share.

title: Network Totals Dashboard
description: Network Totals Dashboard is a storage ability in the Decentralized Storage Quota Management database. Shows network-wide storage totals without trusting any single reporter. Totals are computed from gossiped signed counters; outliers are excluded by median. It takes counter gossip and produces network totals. Tunable parameters: median. Guarantee: no single peer can inflate the totals.
